reviewPolicy: All 33 Treasure Vault Remastered poison afflictions are published. Affliction Forge 0.1.61 supplies repeated exposure, injury-poison delivery, incapacitation for source-level traits, virulent progression, formula stage timing, periodic effects, and ordinary staged effects. Source-specific mechanics that exceed reusable engine contracts remain visible GM Note exceptions rather than bespoke one-entry runtime hooks.

notes: GM Note: If the victim dies while poisoned, the body fully decomposes after 1 minute; the special corpse-preservation and counteract interactions are not automated.
entries.manualComment: GM Note: If the victim dies while poisoned, the body fully decomposes after 1 minute; the special corpse-preservation and counteract interactions are not automated.

notes: GM Note: The Forge does not automate the round-by-round cold/fire alternation or the temporary save-DC changes caused by external cold or fire damage. Apply the current stage damage manually.
entries.manualComment: GM Note: The Forge does not automate the round-by-round cold/fire alternation or the temporary save-DC changes caused by external cold or fire damage. Apply the current stage damage manually.

notes: GM Note: At the start of each turn, the victim must also succeed at a DC 5 flat check or drop one random held item. This inventory/turn-start effect remains manual.
entries.manualComment: GM Note: At the start of each turn, the victim must also succeed at a DC 5 flat check or drop one random held item. This inventory/turn-start effect remains manual.

notes: GM Note: The stage-based weakness to physical and force damage is not created as a PF2e weakness. Because the source lists no interval for any stage, no stage saves are invented; repeated exposure can still raise the stage.
entries.manualComment: GM Note: The stage-based weakness to physical and force damage is not created as a PF2e weakness. Because the source lists no interval for any stage, no stage saves are invented; repeated exposure can still raise the stage.

GM Note: Inability to breathe and reductions to remaining air are not tracked automatically. Creatures that do not need to breathe are immune only to those extra effects, not to the poison damage. No saves are invented for the omitted stage intervals.

notes: GM Note: The damage type depends on whether the target is living or undead. This target-dependent switch is not detected automatically; apply the stage damage manually.

notes: GM Note: The victim’s first successful unarmed attack each round also exposes the struck target to this poison. This transmission to a new target is not triggered automatically.

notes: GM Note: Prone is applied automatically. The stage-dependent flat check before the Stand action is not intercepted automatically.

notes: GM Note: Damage, Off-Guard, and Stunned are automated. The complete prohibition on reactions for the duration of each stage is not separately enforced.

notes: GM Note: The special Stage 3 failure that immediately ends the poison and leaves the victim Paralyzed for 2d6 minutes is not represented by normal stage progression and must be resolved manually.

notes: GM Note: Poison damage and Clumsy are automated. The forced random Steps at the start of each turn remain manual.

notes: GM Note: If the victim reaches 0 HP while poisoned, it must attempt a DC 34 Will save and dies on a failure. The subsequent random adjacent-creature benefit of 20 temporary HP and +1 to attack and damage for 10 minutes is also applied manually.

notes: GM Note: Casting a spell raises the poison DC by 2 for that round and can convert half the stage damage to a spell damage type or mental damage. This dynamic linkage is not automated; apply stage damage manually.
